messages:
alex_chiu: heads up — I opened a small terraform change to the tgw attachment module to stop automatic route propagation for one of the dev VPCs. Trying to avoid leaking overlapping routes into prod TGW.

maria_g: can you paste the diff? not sure which attachment you mean.

alex_chiu: sorry, link: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/terraform/commit/9f3a2b (should be private) — main change is: 
```hcl
resource "aws_ec2_transit_gateway_vpc_attachment" "this" {
  # ...
  options {
    ipv6_support = "disable"
    appliance_mode_support = "enable"
    // new: disable propagation to avoid route overlap with staging
    transit_gateway_default_route_table_association = false
    transit_gateway_default_route_table_propagation = false
  }
}
```

samir: hmm if you turn off propagation we need to ensure we explicitly associate the correct route table and add routes. otherwise traffic will blackhole.

irene: +1. Also we have automation that expects `propagate = true` for the monitoring VPC, so watch for alerts.

alex_chiu: good call. I added a follow-up resource to create an explicit `aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_association` and `aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route` in the same module, but only for the dev attachment. snippet: 
```hcl
resource "aws_ec2_transit_gateway_route_table_association" "dev_assoc" {
  transit_gateway_route_table_id = var.dev_route_table_id
  transit_gateway_attachment_id  = aws_ec2_transit_gateway_vpc_attachment.this.id
}
```

maria_g: can we gate this change behind a workspace var? we don't want it to land in prod workspace by mistake.

alex_chiu: yep, added `var.disable_auto_propagation` and defaulted false. terraform plan in the dev workspace shows only attachment and explicit assoc created.

samir: quick plan output looks ok — no prod impact. But two asks: 1) add a comment in the module README about side effects to route tables, 2) mention the change in the infra-changes doc so oncall knows how to debug connectivity.

irene: tagging deploy-bot to run a dry run in staging: @deploy-bot could you run `tf plan` for workspace staging with this branch? :eyes:

deploy-bot: queued: running `terraform plan -var-file=staging.tfvars` on workspace `staging` for branch `alex/disable-propagation`. ETA ~2m.

alex_chiu: thanks — i'll also open a small PR in docs. cc @maria_g for review of the var naming.

maria_g: will review. also update the k8s loadbalancer manifest docs if any LB depends on the default propagation assumption.

samir: one more note: if we ever re-enable propagation, remember to remove the explicit routes to avoid duplicate/conflicting routes.

alex_chiu: will add a TODO comment in the tf so it's visible. closing loop once deploy-bot returns plan.

deploy-bot: plan finished: no diffs against prod workspace. staging workspace has 2 additions, 0 changes, 0 deletions. link: https://ci.redwood/plan/12345

maria_g: perfect. :thumbsup:

samir: thanks alex — good safe default.
